profile.role_note: Free 4-star Heavy Attack buffer; Outro grants 38% Heavy Attack DMG.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Free 4-star heavy-attack buffer for Jiyan and friends; build him, not worth chasing on banners — he comes from any Convene banner.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Static Mist (or Cadenza) + 5-piece Moonlit Clouds in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Impermanence Heron in the main slot. Aim for a Crit 4-cost, Fusion DMG 3-costs, ATK% 1-costs, and enough Energy Regen to cast his Liberation every rotation; Empyrean Anthem only beats Moonlit Clouds at S4+.

ranked_weapons.name: Static Mist
ranked_weapons.note: Standard 5-star; Crit Rate, Energy Regen, and ATK for the incoming Resonator on Outro. Not a signature — he has none as a 4-star.

ranked_weapons.name: Cadenza
ranked_weapons.note: Concerto Energy on Resonance Skill; smooths rotations. Free last-resort alternative: the 3-star Pistols of Voyager.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Energy Regen for Liberation uptime plus an ATK buff for the incoming Resonator. Heron adds Resonance Energy and more DMG to the next character.

echo_sets.name: Empyrean Anthem
echo_sets.note: Only recommended at S4+; otherwise Moonlit Clouds is ideal, per Game8.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds + Molten Rift
echo_sets.note: Slightly more personal damage at the cost of the full 5-pc ATK buff.

stat_priorities.note: Balance Crit for his coordinated-attack damage.
Fusion DMG on both; swap one to Energy Regen if his Liberation isn't cycling.

build.energy_regen_target: not published; enough to cast Liberation every rotation (swap a 3-cost to ER if needed)

teams.name: Classic: Jiyan + Mortefi + Verina

members.name: Jiyan
members.note: The best Mortefi partner: in his Liberation state every attack is a fast Heavy Attack.

members.name: Mortefi
members.note: Outro grants 38% Heavy Attack DMG; his Liberation turret fires on Heavy and Basic Attacks.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Heals and buffs; doubles as an excellent buffer alongside Mortefi.

teams.rotation: Verina sustains and buffs, Mortefi deploys his Liberation turret and Outro for the 38% Heavy Attack buff, then Jiyan enters his Liberation state and shreds with rapid Heavy Attacks while the turret fires alongside.

teams.name: Alternative: Augusta + Mortefi + Shorekeeper

members.name: Augusta
members.note: Heavy-attack hypercarry; benefits from Mortefi's 38% Heavy Attack DMG Outro.

members.name: Mortefi
members.note: Heavy Attack buffer and coordinated-attack sub-DPS on Empyrean Anthem at S4+.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Stellarealm buffs and healing with minimal field time.

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper deploys Stellarealm, Mortefi drops his Liberation and Outro for the Heavy Attack buff, then Augusta takes her extended heavy-attack window under full buff coverage.
